title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer

Up to £90,000 - London

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Data Platform Engineer to join an innovative technology business investing in its data and AI capabilities.

The business is looking for an experienced engineer to take ownership of the infrastructure, tooling and integrations underpinning its Azure Databricks data platform, ensuring it is secure, reliable, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a hands-on role offering exposure to cloud infrastructure, DevOps, systems integration and data engineering. Working alongside the Data Platform Lead and wider engineering teams, you will play a key role in developing and operating the platform that supports analytics, data products and AI applications across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Building and maintaining Azure infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Administering Azure Databricks workspaces, compute, permissions and Unity Catalog.
  • Designing and maintaining integrations between the data platform and business systems, including Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Developing API integrations and automated workflows to ensure reliable data synchronisation.
  • Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implementing cloud security, identity management and access controls.
  • Establishing monitoring, logging and alerting, investigating and resolving production issues.
  • Monitoring platform performance, capacity and costs, identifying opportunities for optimisation.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in cloud or platform engineering, ideally within Azure.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code.
  • Practical experience administering or supporting Azure Databricks.
  • Understanding of lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake and SQL.
  • Experience building and supporting REST API integrations and automated workflows.
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell or similar scripting languages.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with Unity Catalog and data governance.

What's On Offer?

  • Salary of up to £90,000.
  • Hybrid working in London.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a modern Azure Databricks platform.
  • Significant technical responsibility and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to influence platform architecture and engineering standards.
  • A varied role combining cloud infrastructure, DevOps and systems integration.

If you are an experienced Cloud or Platform Engineer looking to take ownership of a modern data environment, this is a great opportunity to work with Azure and Databricks, helping shape the infrastructure behind an organisation's growing data and AI capabilities.
